entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: An artificial plane created by Serra from pure white mana as a heavenly ideal, with floating islands and a golden dawn.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker who created the Realm and the Serra Angels, and fled after Phyrexian taint.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who fled Phyrexia, later returned with the Weatherlight to rescue refugees and collapse the plane into its powerstone.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: Serra's head archangel who took control with militancy and paranoia and became a tool of the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Visitor to the recreated Serra's Realm in 4308 AR.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders whose black mana tainted the Realm.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship Urza built, into whose powerstone core Serra's Realm was collapsed.

entities.name: Serra Angels
entities.description: Angels created by Serra, divided into five orders: Law, Grace, Reason, Duty, and Truth.

entities.name: Serra's Sanctum
entities.description: Serra's crystal, marble and opal palace suspended in the sky, later taken over by Radiant.

entities.name: Sisterhood of Serra
entities.description: An organization of priestesses devoted to Serra.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane Urza failed to destroy before fleeing.

entities.name: The Jumbles
entities.description: Floating islands thought to harbor Phyrexians but holding refugees.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: Device in which the Weatherlight's powerstone imploded.

events.summary: Serra creates the Realm hoping to build a haven where suffering could be avoided forever.
events.quote: Serra made the Realm in the hopes that she could make a haven where suffering could be avoided forever.

events.summary: After Urza leaves, the Phyrexians attack; repelled, their black mana taints the Realm and Serra proposes an exodus and flees.
events.quote: their black mana forever tainted the realm, causing Serra to propose a massive exodus to the realm inhabitants and flee.

events.summary: Radiant takes control and, trying to expunge Phyrexian influence, becomes their unwitting tool and exterminates loyal Serrans.
events.quote: Radiant became an unwitting tool of the Phyrexians and began exterminating loyal Serrans.

events.summary: Urza returns with the Weatherlight, rescues thousands of refugees and collapses the plane into the ship's powerstone core.
events.quote: rescuing thousands of Serran refugees before finally collapsing the plane into the ship's powerstone core

events.summary: In 4308 AR Karona, Sash and Waistcoat visit a recreated Realm where an angel calling herself Serra says she has been rebuilding it since the powerstone exploded.
events.quote: Serra had been working to rebuild the realm since then.

events.summary: After the Weatherlight's compleation in 4562 AR, the powerstone is used in the Temporal Anchor, where it implodes.
events.quote: the powerstone was used in the Temporal Anchor where it finally imploded.

relations.note: Made it from pure white mana.
relations.quote: an artificial plane created by the planeswalker Serra from pure white mana

relations.note: Created angels as guardians of her plane.
relations.quote: The angels were created by the planeswalker as guardians of her plane
Radiant became an unwitting tool of the Phyrexians
